topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I heard the miller's boy talking, sayin' how the inn up the road, the one with the fine meat and the warm seats, is shutting its doors. Seems the keeper can't pay his way no more, with the taxes as heavy as they are and the road not as busy. It's a somber thought, knowing the place where men gather to talk and drink will be silenced. I think of the times I've walked there, watchin' the smoke rise, feelin' a bit lighter after a long day in the fields. I reckoned the place was as steady as the hill, but now it feels like another part of the world is spinning away. I'll miss the smell of the roasting meat and the sound of the glasses clinking. I wonder what the future holds, but I've always found that the harvest comes, whatever the weather.
